dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Yo! You're back so soon! Did you find the treasure?

choices.text: Why did you come to Fontaine?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Of course I'm here to... Uh... do business! A few of my business partners came here, so of course I came as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, aren't those business partners of yours... Treasure Hoarders or something of the sort?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: No way! I'd never work with people like that! It'd be way too risky...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Uh... Or at least I wouldn't work with them directly. If for some reason I had to work with them, I'd need to find a middleman.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Goodbye! I leave retrieving the Ancient Iron Coins to you, remember to bring any you find to me! I'll definitely buy them for a good price.
